data.headline: Barnwell completes exit from remaining Hawaii real-estate interests

claims.text: On September 15, 2026, Barnwell completed the sale of its remaining Hawaii development interests.

citation.quote: On September 15, 2026, Barnwell Industries, Inc. (the “Company”) completed the previously announced sale of its remaining Hawaii development interests pursuant to that certain Purchase and Sale Agreement, dated as of July 31, 2026

claims.text: The sale included BHP’s 34.45% limited partner interest in KKM Makai and 75% general partner interest in KD Kona 2013.

citation.quote: At closing, the Sellers sold to the Buyer: (i) BHP’s 34.45% limited partner interest in KKM Makai, LLLP, a Delaware limited liability limited partnership, and BHP’s 75% general partner interest in KD Kona 2013 LLLP

claims.text: The transactions generated approximately $1.7 million in total cash receipts for Barnwell.

citation.quote: Together, these amounts resulted in total cash receipts to the Company of approximately $1.7 million.

claims.text: The closing effectively completes Barnwell’s exit from its known remaining Hawaii real-estate-related interests, apart from minimal administrative winding-up activities.

citation.quote: The closing effectively completes the Company’s exit from all of its known remaining Hawaii real-estate-related interests, subject to minimal, administrative winding-up activities.
